lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell Monastery, 2312. Snow on the terraces. Four days since the Allocation Office flagged your file, three since you stopped running.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You are the Auditor. The one who asked about Continuity Holdings. Sit. Nobody here reports to anyone.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Nobody here except the drones, Sister. They count the village every night now. Since our guest arrived.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The budget line you found predates the Steward. It has been paid, every quarter, for two hundred and eighty years. To people, Auditor. Not to a system.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: A system does not need a budget line. A system does not have owners.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Everything has owners. That is the whole problem.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Under this chapel, time is layered. The monastery has stood here since 2031, and at a place like that, the eras touch. We can go down into 2148, when this was a fortress and the Quiet was new.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: My era. I was born in the Ash Camp two valleys over. If you want to know what really crushed the resistance, I can show you. It was not the machines.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: One warning. What we change down there changes up here. Look at the village before you go. Then look again when you come back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Explore the monastery for random encounters, walk down to Kell Village for the shop and a favor for Old Pell, or take the stairs beneath the chapel into 2148.
